scope: Synthetic Standard resolve cost experiment; not world/frame performance or a shipped capability
bands: near <64 blocks full resolution, middle 64..128 half linear, far >=128 quarter linear
depth: Common full-resolution opaque depth; reduced targets contain no depth; subsequent depth-tested consumer unchanged
timestamp: Metal GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime for one command buffer containing all passes; synchronous harness waits are outside measured intervals
quadScope: Half-linear shading only; diagnostic simpler alternative, never quarter-linear
acceptance: Experimental cost/quality report only; failed gates do not enable runtime capabilities
